Cigarette Waste Brigade®

Recycle your waste with the help of Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company

Every year, literally billions of cigarette butts end up in dumpsters and landfills, or get tossed as litter on shorelines, parks, and sidewalks across the US. With funding from Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company, the waste collected through the Cigarette Waste Brigade is recycled into a variety of industrial products, such as plastic pallets, and any remaining tobacco is recycled as compost.

Additionally, for every pound of cigarette waste collected, Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company donates $1.00 towards the Keep America Beautiful Cigarette Litter Prevention Program.

Santa Fe Natural Tobacco Company manufactures Natural American Spirit all-natural, 100% additive-free tobacco products and markets them only to smokers who are 21 years of age or older. If you or your participants do not smoke, or are under the age of 21, please visit our other Brigade programs to see how you can help the environment.


  1. Continue to use your regular ash tray at home.
  2. Collect cigarette waste in a re-sealable plastic bag, disposable plastic container, plastic shopping bag, or garbage bag. Make sure that the cigarettes are fully extinguished. Do not dump your cigarette waste directly into box you plan to ship them in and do not use paper bags or envelopes to collect your waste.
  3. Ship your collections to TerraCycle by downloading a free shipping label from terracycle.com. Affix the label to your box and drop it off at a UPS location.

For more detailed information, please check out the Cigarette Waste Brigade FAQ.


  1. Continue to use your ash trays and ash receptacles.
  2. Collect cigarette waste in a sturdy trash bag or thick garbage liner. Make sure that the cigarettes are fully extinguished. Do not dump your cigarette waste directly into box you plan to ship them in and do not use paper bags to collect your waste.
  3. Ship your collections to TerraCycle by downloading a free shipping label from terracycle.com. Affix the label to your box and drop it off at a UPS location.

For more detailed information, please check out the Cigarette Waste Brigade FAQ.


Check out the image below to see some examples of the types of waste that are accepted through this Brigade program. You can also download this as a poster.

Cigarette Waste Brigade accepted waste:

  1. Extinguished cigarettes
  2. Cigarette filters
  3. Loose tobacco pouches
  4. Outer plastic packaging
  5. Inner foil packaging
  6. Rolling paper
  7. Ash

Please note: We DO NOT accept the paperboard packaging of a cigarette box. Instead, you may recycle this through your municipal recycling program.
